summary: The Hartford Insurance Group, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a definitive agreement to sell its Hartford Funds business to Wellington Investment Advisors Holdings, LLP, parent of Wellington Management Company LLP. Consideration includes $300 million cash at close plus ongoing quarterly payments representing 95% of after-tax available cash from the combined business over an expected 7-year period, with net present value estimated at $1.9 billion (11% discount rate). The board supports the deal. Closing is expected Q1 2027, subject to regulatory and fund approvals. Hartford Funds will be reported as discontinued operations from Q2 2026. What to watch: regulatory clearance timeline and the performance-based earnout structure affecting ultimate proceeds.
